description: This file defines a PHP class Vtiger_LanguageExport which extends Vtiger_Package and provides functionality to manage language packs for vtiger CRM, including registering, deregistering, and retrieving language information.

classes.name: Vtiger_LanguageExport
classes.description: A class providing APIs for packaging, registering, deregistering, and retrieving language files for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: __getUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for inserting new language records.

methods.name: __initSchema
methods.description: Initializes the language table schema if it does not exist and populates it with available languages.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new language pack, inserting or updating information in the database.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Removes a language pack based on its prefix, except for core language 'en_us'.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all language information, with an option to include inactive languages.
